title: Nexus RunAcceptRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/daemon/compute/runs/{run_id}/accept — atomically commit a succeeded Run's proposals into the World (V1.147 P0 direct lane).

timeline_event_ids_to_accept.description: Optional subset of timeline events from the proposals to accept, referenced by their stable index-based id: 'evt_0', 'evt_1', ... assigned by position in the Run's proposals.timeline_events array. Only the referenced events are appended to the timeline; all timeline events are accepted when this field is absent or null. An unknown id (out of range, or not of the form 'evt_<index>') rejects the whole Accept with 422 invalid_input. State updates and new knowledge entries are always all-or-nothing with the Accept action.
